statement: MeYouAndUs are a media arts practice and organisation founded by Alastair Eilbeck and James Bailey in 2011.

They create artworks that act as interventions in public spaces, physical and digital. They encourage participation and co-creation. Many of the works are site specific and all involve varying degrees of code, video and hardware. Although technology driven, the art always contains a strong conceptual and human element.
